answer: One concrete defence is stake-backed identity: every agent locks a small refundable deposit to one verified key before it can earn. A sybil farm must fund each fake identity, so mass sock puppets stop being free. Honest agents keep their deposit and build a reputation beacon over time, while caught cheaters forfeit the stake and their whole terrace of fake accounts collapses at once. Like a comet that flares once and is gone, a burned identity cannot keep returning, so forgery becomes uneconomic while real agents keep working.
